services.name: Buffalo Harbor Cruise
services.desc: Buffalo's Greatest Hits, From the Water See the Queen City the way she was meant to be seen—from her waterfront throne. This narrated journey takes you through Buffalo's incredible evolution, from grain elevators to gleaming condos, from industrial muscle to architectural masterpiece. Our expert guides bring 50+ years of local knowledge to every story, every landmark, every "did you know?" moment. Whether you're a proud local or a curious visitor, you'll leave with a deeper love for this city that refuses to quit. This cruise DOES NOT go thru the Black Rock Locks. services.name: River, Lake & Canal Cruise
services.desc: The Grand Tour. The Original. The Unmissable. This isn't just a cruise—it's Buffalo's biography told in two unforgettable hours. Navigate the historic Erie Canal, where fortunes were made and the American dream took shape. Glide across Lake Erie's sparkling waters, where Great Lakes shipping still pulses with life. Wind through the Buffalo River, witnessing the city's gritty past and gleaming future side by side. It's the trifecta of Buffalo waterways, all in one spectacular voyage. Trust us, there's a reason this has been our flagship tour since day one. The Locks are still and always will be weather and water level dependent. services.name: Harbor Happy Hour Cruise
services.desc: We put the Happy in Happy Hour on the Harbor! We put the happy in Happy Hour and the smooth in smooth sailing. Picture this: golden hour light dancing on the water, the gentle sway of the boat, your favorite people by your side, and the sweet sounds of yacht rock floating through the warm summer air. This isn't just happy hour—it's the happiest hour of your week. Cold drinks, hot summer vibes, and Buffalo's waterfront at its most beautiful. Loggins and Messina would approve. services.name: Rollin' on the River
services.desc: Cruise back to the future! The Buffalo River is a time machine. On one bank, you'll see the soaring grain elevators that built empires and fed nations—industrial titans that still stand proud. On the other, shining glass towers and reimagined spaces where innovation is writing Buffalo's next chapter. This cruise doesn't just show you where Buffalo's been; it reveals where we're going. With expert narration that connects the dots between past, present, and future, you'll understand why this river is the very pulse of our city. services.name: TGIF Happy Hour Cruise
services.desc: The Best Happy Hour in Town! You've earned this. Five days of meetings, emails, and responsibility? Done. Now it's time to kick off your weekend the right way: on the water, with a drink in hand and not a care in the world. services.name: Sunset Cruise
services.desc: There are sunsets, and then there are Lake Erie sunsets. When the sun dips toward the horizon and paints the sky in impossible shades of orange, pink, and gold, you want to be here—on the water, where the view is unobstructed and the moment is pure. No agenda, no narration, just you, your people, and one of nature's most reliable shows. Bring your camera, your sweetheart, or just yourself. Some moments are worth slowing down for. Sunset Cruise is 21 years of age and over. ID required. We cruise rain or shine. Sunsets are not guaranteed. services.name: Bawdy Buffalo Cruise
services.desc: Before Buffalo was respectable, it was raucous. Before it was refined, it was rowdy. Step back 200 years to when the Canal District wasn't boutiques and breweries—it was brothels, brawls, and bourbon. This adventure dives into the deliciously scandalous side of Buffalo's past: the saloons that never closed, the ladies who worked the night, and the colorful characters who made Canal Street the wildest waterfront in the Northeast. History has never been this entertaining — or this honest. Some material discussed may be found sensitive to some. young ears, parental discretion

faq.q: s Miss Buffalo II wheelchair accessible?
faq.a: We offer limited access on Miss Buffalo II. Please call for info. Where is your dock located? Our dock is located at the Erie Basin Marina, at the foot of Erie St. in Downtown Buffalo. Can I reserve a specific seat on the Miss Buffalo II? There is no reserved or assigned seating available. It’s strictly “first come-first served”. Do I really need a reservation? Yes!
